summary: A full sync prunes local rows only inside the window it actually fetched: /transactions prunes within its action-date window, and --since or other --param filters skip reconcile.
reason: The 4.33.0 generator prunes the whole local table against the IDs a --full sync saw; Hostex transactions are always fetched through a date window (action time, operator timezone), so unbounded pruning would delete older history backfilled with --resource-param.
validated_outcome: Tests: in-window transactions deleted upstream are pruned while older rows survive, a filtered fetch emits exactly one partial_window skip event, and a whole-table fetch still prunes. Live probe confirmed the /transactions window filters on the action_at date. The prune bounds use the operator-local date at the start of action_at (Hostex stamps the operator's offset), covered by TestReconcileDateWindowUsesOperatorLocalDate.
